inputs.prompt: This sheet shows the first frame of each shot of a short video, in reading order: left to right, then top to bottom. Describe the video as JSON only, with no other text: {"shots": [one short line per shot, in order, saying what it shows], "hook": "the words written on screen in the first shots, or an empty string", "style": "the tone of the video, in a few words"}

inputs.string_a: Here is the description of a short trend video. Write the post of a remix of it in which a fox in a cream cable-knit sweater, corduroy trousers and a leather satchel performs the same shots, in the same tone. Answer as JSON only, with no other text: {"caption": "one or two short sentences in English", "hashtags": ["five hashtags, without #"], "onscreen": "a short hook to write on screen, in English"}. Never name a real person or a brand.
